verdict.rationale: The story asks about exporting data to switch away from a vendor, but the IRS is a mandatory government tax authority that a taxpayer cannot 'leave'. That makes the exit axis a category error for this kind of product. The only related item is a bare 'Tax record (transcript)' page title, which documents no bulk export, no open formats and no exit path, so the verdict would be 'none' even if the axis applied.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
